per_sentence.section_title: 4.3 Molecular Property Prediction as Graph-Level Classification
per_sentence.text: More recently, graph neural networks (GNNs) following the Message Passing Neural Network (MPNN) framework have been applied to molecular property prediction, where model performance is determined by the specific message passing algorithm employed (Gong & Maday, 2023).
